title: Grateful Dead Live at San Jose Civic Auditorium on 1972-08-20
lineage: Master cassettes played back on Nakamichi Dragon > Digital Audio Labs Card Deluxe soundcard (96Mhz/24 bit)> HD > Adobe Audition; L3 Multimaximizer>Waves Z-Noise; Dithered and downsampled to 44.1 MHz / 16 bit; Flac Encoded
source: Sony TC-124 with Sony Stereo Mic (Pacific Stereo Cassettes)

ai_review.summary: A muddy, slightly fast tape with odd noises, yet the soaring "The Other One" makes it worthwhile.
ai_review.review: The recording suffers from muddiness, a half‑step speed increase, and occasional glitches (notably on "Bertha" and a cut at the end of "Truckin'"). Despite these flaws, reviewers highlight the powerful performance of "The Other One" as the main draw, and one fan simply declares the music rocks their soul.

ai_rating.rationale: Two reviews (3★ and 5★) give an average of 4★; performance is praised for a key jam while the audio issues lower overall enjoyment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Muddy mix, noticeable half‑step speed increase, occasional weird noise and a cut at the end of "Truckin'"; overall not great but passable for the second disc.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Listeners are advised to start from "Bird Song" and treat Disk 2 as a continuation of Disk 1; the show’s flow is uneven due to audio issues.

band_member_comments.Jerry: The 'ravenous Tiger' (Garcia's guitar) doesn't quite come through in this recording.
